action_inputs.description: Which LDAP utility; optional when only one exists.
action_inputs.label: LDAP utility (IDD- id, pk or name; optional)
action_inputs.name: onb_ldap

label: POC Onboarding: Verify LDAP
mcp_tool_description: Run Verify Connection (bind and search) on an LDAP utility (onb_ldap: IDD- id, pk or name; omit when one exists) and return the real error text with a hint (bad bind credentials, unreachable host or port, LDAPS certificate, wrong base DN) plus the edit link. Call it after the user creates the utility in the UI. Runs as a job: poll the returned id with fetch_job. Requires a CloudBolt admin caller.
